title: Distance Between Two Points Of Me
synopsis: A Ukrainian filmmaker's reflection on displacement and self — the distance between the person she was before leaving home and the person shaped by everything since, built in the AI around a true story of a sister and a home someone chose to stay in.
awards: Gold Winner — The Telly Awards, General Animation: Short Form (Under 40 Minutes) 2025

Official Selection — AI International Film Festival 2025
